confidence_reason: The main company website and one sustainability report were reviewed. Several claim-level signals were retained.
entity_context_short: No external signal was retained. Sector exposure remains high because of complex supply chains and labour-risk exposure.
executive_summary: The scan identified medium overall claim risk. The main issues concern climate-neutrality wording, certification terminology and broad environmental language.
entity_resolution_note: The company name was resolved to puratos.com. Confirm that the reviewed domain and entity are correct.

top_findings.title: Climate-neutrality or offsetting claim
top_findings.excerpt: Puratos marks major sustainability milestone with carbon neutral operations.
top_findings.why_it_matters: The wording may imply complete neutrality without making the emissions boundary, residual emissions and role of offsets clear.
top_findings.evidence_gap: Scope, baseline, methodology, residual emissions, offset use and reporting period.
top_findings.recommended_wording: Separate verified emissions reductions from any offsetting and disclose scopes, baseline, methodology, residual emissions, offset use and progress.

top_findings.title: Sustainability label / certification claim
top_findings.excerpt: Cacao-Trace, our own certified sustainable cocoa sourcing program.
top_findings.why_it_matters: The wording may be understood as an independent sustainability certification.
top_findings.evidence_gap: Scheme owner, criteria, independent verifier, audit basis, scope and validity period.
top_findings.recommended_wording: Name the scheme owner, criteria, independent verification basis, audited scope and validity period, or clarify that it is a company programme rather than an independent certification.

top_findings.title: Generic environmental claim
top_findings.excerpt: We support you in creating nutritious and more sustainable breads.
top_findings.why_it_matters: The comparative benefit and environmental attribute are not clear from the wording alone.
top_findings.evidence_gap: Specific attribute, comparison baseline, method, product scope, period and limitations.
top_findings.recommended_wording: Specify the exact environmental attribute, product scope, comparison baseline, method, evidence, reporting period and limitations.

priority_actions.title: Review client-facing green claims
priority_actions.description: Review the exact climate, certification and broad environmental wording used on webpages, campaigns and product communications.

priority_actions.title: Close substantiation gaps
priority_actions.description: Create a claim-specific evidence file covering scope, method, baseline, reporting period, limitations, verification status and approval owner.

priority_actions.title: Implement claim governance
priority_actions.description: Require sustainability, legal, compliance and marketing approval before high-risk claims or sustainability labels are published.
